An [[Eaglecrest Axe]] is a very large type of [[axe]]. They are short and feature a massive, crescent-shaped blade, the back of which features an eagle head design. The handle is shaped like one of the bird's legs and ends with its talons.

==Acquisition==

'''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]'''
* [[Raven's Point]]
** [[Destroyer Chest ]]

==Dye==
This item cannot be dyed.

== Trivia ==
* This weapon is based on ''Caroline Coronel's'' winning design from the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|2007 Design-a-Weapon Contest]]. (The same player had a design that was an honorable mention in the [[Design-a-Weapon (2005)|2005 Design-a-Weapon contest]].)
